documents_expected.why: call page; the only page about this grant

eligibility.rule: Community groups doing practical local nature recovery projects
eligibility.quote: Grants of up to £5,000 for community groups who want to undertake practical and positive local nature recovery projects.

notes: The page lists project examples and says to get in touch; no form, documents or steps are published. The National Park boundary rule is stated for the landowners strand, not this one. Checked on 2026-11-16: the authority's own beacons-npa.gov.uk pages (bannau.wales serves the same site) include a Community Nature Recovery Fund page under the Sustainable Development Fund, but that is a separate £50–£500 Local Nature Partnership fund, not this up-to-£5,000 grant, so it is not expected here. It may be worth listing as its own programme.
